labels.shortDescription: Access page: button that gives the chosen person the chosen role
labels.value: Give access

labels.shortDescription: Access page: button that gives the chosen person an extra permission
labels.value: Give permission

labels.shortDescription: Access page: extra permission given; {0} person, {1} permission
labels.value: {0} now has the {1} permission.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what BarnCRM Bulk Delete grants
labels.value: Delete many records at once from a Find query, with undo from the Recycle Bin. Give it together with Find and Export.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what BarnCRM Bulk Update grants
labels.value: Set, clear or copy fields on many records at once from a Find query, with undo. Give it together with Find and Export.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: confirm giving; {0} person, {1} permission
labels.value: Give {0} the {1} permission?

labels.shortDescription: Access page: confirm removing; {0} person, {1} permission
labels.value: Remove the {1} permission from {0}? Their roles stay in place.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: warning for an extra permission that removes data
labels.value: This permission lets the person remove data. Give it only to someone you trust to do that.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what BarnCRM Duplicate Review grants
labels.value: Review suggested duplicate people and households. Works only for people with a Sales Cloud or Service Cloud license.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what BarnCRM Erase People grants
labels.value: Erase a person on their request (the right to be forgotten), which cannot be undone.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what BarnCRM Find and Export grants
labels.value: Build, run, save and export Find queries and use Data Hygiene, seeing only the records the person can already see.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: label of the extra permission picker
labels.value: Extra permission

labels.shortDescription: Access page: what BarnCRM Metadata Admin grants
labels.value: Save changes on the Custom metadata page of BarnCRM Settings, which changes the org's configuration. For people who already administer the org.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: placeholder of the extra permission picker
labels.value: Choose an extra permission

labels.shortDescription: Access page: extra permission removed; {0} person, {1} permission
labels.value: {0} no longer has the {1} permission.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: text under the Extra permissions heading
labels.value: Some features are in no role. Give them to a person here, alongside their role. Only permissions given here are listed: one that comes with a role is not.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: heading of the extra permissions section
labels.value: Extra permissions

labels.shortDescription: Access page: may change roles but not give permissions
labels.value: You can see who has each extra permission but not change it. Giving one needs the Assign Permission Sets permission in Salesforce, which comes with the BarnCRM Admin role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: an extra permission nobody has been given
labels.value: No one has been given this permission here.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: the chosen permission is not one the page may give
labels.value: That permission is not one this page can give. Reload the page and choose from the list.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: one person refused; {0} person, {1} permission, {2} reason
labels.value: {0} could not be given {1}. Their Salesforce license may not allow what it grants. Salesforce said: {2}

labels.shortDescription: Access page: removal refused; {0} person, {1} permission, {2} reason
labels.value: {1} could not be removed from {0}. Salesforce said: {2}

labels.shortDescription: Access page: the person lacks Assign Permission Sets
labels.value: You cannot give or remove extra permissions. That needs the Assign Permission Sets permission in Salesforce, which comes with the BarnCRM Admin role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: after a role is given; {0} person, {1} role
labels.value: {0} now has the {1} role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: text before the link to the automatic access guide
labels.value: Add people often? A user access policy, created once in Setup, can give each new user a role for you.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: link that opens the automatic access guide page
labels.value: Set up automatic access

labels.shortDescription: Access page: button that closes a confirmation without changing anything
labels.value: Cancel

labels.shortDescription: Access page: asked before a role is given; {0} person, {1} role
labels.value: Give {0} the {1} role?

labels.shortDescription: Access page: heading of the confirmation shown before a role is given
labels.value: Give access

labels.shortDescription: Access page: asked before a role is removed; {0} person, {1} role
labels.value: Remove the {1} role from {0}? Any other role they hold stays in place.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: heading of the confirmation shown before a role is removed
labels.value: Remove access

labels.shortDescription: Access page: explains why creating a user happens in Setup
labels.value: BarnCRM cannot create a person or hand out a Salesforce license. Create the user in Setup first, then come back here and give them a role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: link that opens the Users page in Setup
labels.value: Create a user in Setup

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when the role is still being rebuilt by the platform
labels.value: This role is still being prepared. Wait a moment, reload the page, and try again.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when a person or a role was not chosen
labels.value: Choose a person and a role before you continue.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when removing the only remaining BarnCRM Admin
labels.value: You cannot remove the last person from the BarnCRM Admin role. Give the role to someone else first.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when the user may not change roles
labels.value: You do not have permission to change roles. The Manage BarnCRM Settings permission is required, and it comes with the BarnCRM Admin role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when the chosen role is missing from the org
labels.value: That role was not found. Reload the page, and if it still does not appear, upgrade or reinstall BarnCRM Core.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when the person is not allowed to read the roles at all
labels.value: You can see this page but you cannot see who holds each role. Ask someone with the BarnCRM Admin role to tell you, or to give you that role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when a role change fails for an unexpected reason
labels.value: Something went wrong while changing this role. What happened is recorded in the Error Log (BarnCRM Settings, Error Log).

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when the chosen person is missing or inactive
labels.value: That person was not found, or their account is no longer active. Search for them again.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: message shown while the roles are loading
labels.value: Loading roles

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown on a role card that nobody holds
labels.value: No one holds this role yet.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: one line explaining what the page is for
labels.value: Give a colleague access by picking their name and a role, and see who holds each role today.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: page heading
labels.value: Access

labels.shortDescription: Access page: notice shown to a user who may look but not change roles
labels.value: You can see this page but you cannot change roles. Ask someone with the BarnCRM Admin role to make the change, or to give you that role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: button that takes a role away from a person
labels.value: Remove

labels.shortDescription: Access page: after a role is removed; {0} person, {1} role
labels.value: {0} no longer has the {1} role.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: label of the role picker
labels.value: Role

labels.shortDescription: Access page: placeholder text of the role picker
labels.value: Choose a role

labels.shortDescription: Access page: label of the person search box
labels.value: Find a person

labels.shortDescription: Access page: shown when a search matches nobody
labels.value: No active users match that search. Check the spelling, or create the user in Setup first.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: placeholder text of the person search box
labels.value: Type a name or an email address

labels.shortDescription: Access page: warning shown before someone removes their own admin role
labels.value: You are about to remove your own BarnCRM Admin role. You will lose access to BarnCRM Settings.

labels.shortDescription: Access page: heading of the message shown when something fails
labels.value: That did not work

labels.shortDescription: Access page: heading of the message shown when a change succeeds
labels.value: Done

labels.shortDescription: Access page: heading above the list of people who hold a role
labels.value: People in this role

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: installer not given the admin role; {0} is the attempts
labels.value: Warning: the BarnCRM Admin role was still being prepared after {0} attempts, so it was not given to the person who installed BarnCRM. They already have the BarnCRM Admin permission set, so BarnCRM Settings works. To finish, open BarnCRM Settings, then Access, and give them the BarnCRM Admin role.
